scope: Block 1 summary/resilience only; detailed interstellar economy belongs to Block 4.
rules: Economic resilience changes only from production, consumption, policy, infrastructure, trade or disruption causes.
Post-scarcity is contextual rather than universal.
Block 1 does not synthesize market prices, shipping routes or trade volumes.
A trade interruption may modify resilience only when an actual dependency exists.
Economic state can influence demographics/politics without deterministically forcing a single political result.
